introHtml: PL pocket utility knives offer a reliable cutting tool for everyday tasks, from opening boxes to cutting rope. When you add your logo to these compact knives, you give your team or customers a practical item they'll reach for daily. Options like the Leatherman® Skeletool KBX Stainless provide a sleek stainless steel finish, while other models feature wood or textured handles. Choose laser engraving or pad printing for crisp, long-lasting branding that stands up to heavy use.
